bodies.name: _SCSIHGetConfiguration
bodies.control_flow: Read8 HCNTRL135; replace flags4000 from bit0; clear bits40/1 when40 set, setup environment, pause iff bit4 clear, prepare config, typed firmware getConfig, hardware config, restore old control iff originally running; sync, return0.

bodies.name: _SCSIHGetMemoryTable
bodies.control_flow: Byte fields and halfword sizes only across descriptor0/1/2/4; qout8*(ucharScbs+1), firmware word04 stride, minimum4*stride; table4.size retained/copied to minimum; table3 untouched. Firmware index uchar.

bodies.name: _SCSIHApplyMemoryTable
bodies.control_flow: Publish qout C4/activeHiobs538/scbBuffersD0 pointers before failure; quotient table1 ushort size/firmware stride truncated uchar; lower count<=3 returns1 without count publication, lower>=4 publishes byte; otherwise return0.

bodies.name: _SCSIHInitialize
bodies.control_flow: WriteHCNTRL4; optional hardware5C seqStretchWorkaround then optional firmware80 configureScbRam; firmware54 setupSequencer failure returns-1 immediately. Success hardware reset, firmware58 resetSoftware, HardwareInitialize with unchanged incomingr28, optional flags40000000 ResetScsi+Delay4000, start sequencer, sync return0. Reference/native onlyr31 local.

bodies.name: _SCSIHSetupHardware
bodies.control_flow: Interleaved192304 owner: select actual SCSIHardware[uchar hardwareMode] and publish pointerHHCB244; no invented validation or allocation.

bodies.name: _SCSIHSizeSEEPROM
bodies.control_flow: Read control/pause ifrunning; hardwareMode0 presence write/read30 bit8 failure goes through restore. worddc lowbyte0->64,1->128,other->0; restore and return.

bodies.name: _SCSIHReadSEEPROM
bodies.control_flow: Read/pause; hardwareMode0 presence failure returns1 WITHOUT restore. Write30=32/waitbit16; signed wordCount loop actual ReadE2Register(wordOffset+i,handle*,widthbyte); write30=0, conditional restore, return0.

bodies.name: _SCSIHWriteSEEPROM
bodies.control_flow: Read/pause; mode0 presence failure returns1 WITHOUT restore. widthbyte selects enable192/address|768/10bits or48/address|192/8bits. Real SendE2Address, waitbit16, signed loop, waitbit1, real WriteE2Register with ushort data, disable/send0/write30=0, restore return0.

bodies.name: _SCSIHSetUnitHandle
bodies.control_flow: Publish HHCB pointer, target/lun byte fields and device pointerHHCB32+10*target into16-byte unit prefix; preserve all other bytes.

bodies.name: _SCSIHFreeUnitHandle
bodies.control_flow: Genuine no-op for unit-or-HHCB void* alias; no reads/writes. Actual direct two native/reference leaves; public alias ABI parser remains explicitly deferred to16.

bodies.name: _SCSIHDisableIRQ
bodies.control_flow: Read8 HCNTRL135; clear bit2 by AND253, forward uchar to real SCSIhWriteHCNTRL, sync. Wrapper owns read; hardware callee owns resulting write.

bodies.name: _SCSIHEnableIRQ
bodies.control_flow: Read8 HCNTRL135; set bit2 by OR2, forward uchar to real SCSIhWriteHCNTRL, sync. Distinct operation-owner attribution retained.

bodies.name: _SCSIHPollIRQ
bodies.control_flow: HardwareFlags100000 selects real SCSIhWWReadINTSTAT(handle-pointer), otherwise direct OSMReadUExact8 aggregate-handle+145; return low four bits as uchar.

bodies.name: _SCSIHQueueHIOB
bodies.control_flow: Follow HIOB->unit->HHCB, publish HIOB into activeHiobs[ucharSCB], then typed firmware.deliverScb(HHCB,HIOB), sync; all four real callback modes execute.

bodies.name: _SCSIHQueueSpecialHIOB
bodies.control_flow: Rawfn-1 normalized8-way table:1AbortTask,2ScsiBusReset(HIOB.context.HHCB,HIOB)+status1+Complete,3typed setupBDR,4/8sync only,6conditional flags100000 publication+status1+Complete,7AbortTaskSet. Raw5/outside default returns without sync.

bodies.name: _SCSIHPowerManagement
bodies.control_flow: Ignore eventWord; actual CheckHostIdle true->1 else2, no invented power transitions or controls.

bodies.name: _SCSIHApplyDeviceTable
bodies.control_flow: Genuine input-erased constant-zero stub; unspecified parameter declaration preserved, no extra guessed formal or memory side effect.

bodies.name: _SCSIHCheckHostIdle
bodies.control_flow: Unsigned byte index loop to numberScbs; first activeHiobs entry other than ffffffff returns0; empty/exhausted loop returns1.

bodies.name: _SCSIHCheckDeviceIdle
bodies.control_flow: Unsigned byte loop skips ffffffff; follows real HIOB.unit.target byte and returns0 only matching target; exhausted/empty returns1.

bodies.name: _SCSIHSuppressNegotiation
bodies.control_flow: Real device-idle failure returns before MMIO. HardwareMode1 reads135/pauses iff4 clear. getOption ushort==143 triggers xferOptAssign(HHCB,target,ushort0). Mode1 originally-running restores direct8 control.

bodies.name: _SCSIHForceNegotiation
bodies.control_flow: Real device-idle failure returns. Device.rate&129 selects ushort143 else0; mode1 preserves control with conditional pause/restore, typed xferOptAssign HHCB,target,option always on idle.

bodies.name: _SCSIHGetHWInformation
bodies.control_flow: Read/pause; narrow/wide identity, ADAPTEC AIC11bytes noNUL, IDbyte1 ORhostID, deviceID nibbles|48, bus/device decimal, PCI16&fffffffe hex with historical9->@ threshold<=8. Preserve neutralbits/prefix; mode0/1 thresholds,16 actual option/Fast20 callbacks, typed getProfileParameters(info,HHCB), restore.

bodies.name: _SCSIHPutHWInformation
bodies.control_flow: Read/pause; write info.hostID at actual hardware.configurationRegister and HHCB byte; mode0 fifo direct, mode1 flagword and two ordered volatile FIFO byte publications for split/unsplit. Real updateDataFifoThrsh, successive flags word stores, MMIO2 masksC7/flags, typed putProfileParameters(info,HHCB), restore.

bodies.name: _SCSIHEnableExpStatus
bodies.control_flow: Only flags20000 gate: set hardwareFlags20000, real PauseAndWait, firmware.setBreakPoint(HHCB,uchar2), real UnPause; no extra sync.

bodies.name: _SCSIHDisableExpStatus
bodies.control_flow: Only flags20000 gate: clear hardwareFlags20000, real PauseAndWait, firmware.clearBreakPoint(HHCB,uchar2), real UnPause.

bodies.name: _SCSIHEnableExtScbRam
bodies.control_flow: Read control/pause ifrunning; typed getScbRamCtrls and actual hardware masks. Return previous enabled state. Available+disabled clears disablemask; available always publishes low hostAddress.words3 to8-bit MMIO240; restore ifrunning.

bodies.name: _SCSIHDisableExtScbRam
bodies.control_flow: Read control/pause ifrunning; available state determines old enabled return. Only oldenabled writes control|disablemask; unavailable returns0; conditional restore.

bodies.name: _SCSIHExtScbRAMAvail
bodies.control_flow: Read control/pause ifrunning; return boolean getScbRamCtrls&actual ramAvailableMask, conditional restore; no guessed constants replacing descriptor masks.

bodies.name: _SCSIHReadScratchRam
bodies.control_flow: Read/pause; signed offset>63 chooses+48 else+32; initial value truncates uchar, subsequent first+i not retruncated. Signed count controls ordered8-bit reads into destination; conditional restore.

bodies.name: _SCSIHWriteScratchRam
bodies.control_flow: Read/pause; identical signed threshold and initial uchar truncation, signed loop sends each source byte to first+i; conditional restore.

bodies.name: _SCSIHReadHADDR
bodies.control_flow: Read control/pause ifrunning; four ordered byte reads136..139 into destination0..3, conditional WriteHCNTRL restore.
